card.summary: A research topic may need a quick briefing or a deeper explanation. I built a typed knowledge pipeline that turns one authored study into bilingual reading routes with a source trail.
card.evidence: Outputs: English/Traditional Chinese T1, T5, and T30 reading files plus HTML reader pages.

sources.role: Historical live delivery and planned-budget revision record
Current TALK duration model; not the historical Contract 1.8 execution version

en.subtitle: One study, several ways to read it.
en.lead: I wanted research outputs that fit a reader's time without losing the question, the reasoning, or the sources. Study Atlas makes the reading route part of the delivery.

sections.heading: The reader problem
paragraphs: A one-minute briefing and a thirty-minute explanation need different routes through the same material. A shorter version still needs a conclusion and enough context to stand on its own; a longer version needs room for the derivation.

Study Atlas organizes a supported paper, repository, web source, or topic into a study with bilingual knowledge cards, source locators, and explicit narrative order. Each reading budget has its own route through those cards.

sections.heading: The choice I made
paragraphs: I made the authored meaning explicit in a typed Semantic IR: the question, claims, sources, bilingual card content, and reading order. A Python compiler expands that into study files, and a separate renderer builds the reader HTML.

This keeps presentation changes separate from the knowledge being presented. It requires more authoring structure, but gives the compiler something concrete to check and regenerate. The normal new-study path also refuses to overwrite an existing destination.

sections.heading: What it produces today
paragraphs: Existing outputs include English and Traditional Chinese files for T1, T5 and T30 reading depths, plus HTML readers with language and depth controls. The excerpt above shows two cards from an actual delivery.

The historical walkthrough below follows a September 13, 2026 reading-budget rejection and revision, with the evidence for each step. Passing a delivery check does not establish scientific correctness or faster human reading; those require source review and rehearsal.

zh-TW.subtitle: 同一份研究，給讀者不同深度的入口。
zh-TW.lead: 我希望研究產出能配合讀者的時間，也保留問題、推理與來源。Study Atlas 把閱讀路徑納入交付本身。

sections.heading: 讀者的問題
paragraphs: 一分鐘的簡報和三十分鐘的說明，需要不同的閱讀路徑。短版本仍要有能獨立成立的結論與脈絡，長版本則需要空間展開推導。
Study Atlas 把論文、程式碼或網頁資料整理成雙語知識卡，保存來源位置與敘事順序，再為不同閱讀深度安排卡片路徑。

sections.heading: 我的關鍵選擇
paragraphs: 我用具型別的中介表示（Semantic IR）保存問題、主張、來源、雙語內容與閱讀順序。Python 編譯器把它展開成研究檔案，再由獨立的 renderer 產生 HTML。
內容與呈現分開，讓版面可以修改而不必重寫研究內容。代價是作者需要填寫更明確的結構，但編譯器也因此能檢查並重新產生交付檔；建立新研究時會拒絕覆寫既有目錄。

sections.heading: 目前可看見的結果
paragraphs: 既有產出包含 T1、T5、T30 三種閱讀深度的雙語稿件，以及可切換語言與深度的 HTML reader。上方摘錄展示其中兩張實際交付的卡片。
下方歷史展示重現 2026-09-13 的閱讀預算拒絕與修訂：每一步都標明它依據的是記錄、計算或保存的產物。檢查通過不代表研究結論正確或真人讀得更快；這兩件事仍需來源核對與試讀。

en.title: At inference time point maps derived from depth and cameras are more accurate than the direct point-map head
en.body: Table 3 compares two point-cloud routes from the same model on ETH3D. The direct point-map head has Overall error 0.709, while unprojecting depth with predicted cameras yields 0.677. The authors attribute the gain to decomposing point-map estimation into simpler depth and camera subproblems. Multi-task training therefore does not require every direct head to be the final delivery path.
en.takeaway: Keep multiple supervised paths during training then use known relations to choose the more reliable delivery path

zh-TW.title: 推論時由深度與相機反投影得到的點圖比直接點圖頭更準
zh-TW.body: 表 3 在 ETH3D 比較同一模型的兩條點雲路徑：直接點圖頭的 Overall 誤差為 0.709，將深度圖配合預測相機反投影至 3D 則為 0.677。作者將差異歸因於把複雜點圖問題分解為深度與相機這些較單純子問題。這也顯示多任務訓練不要求最終一定使用每個直接輸出。
zh-TW.takeaway: 訓練時保留多路監督，交付時再用已知關係選擇更穩定的路徑

en.title: The paper does not establish whether its design principles work for everyday cross-domain tasks
en.body: Training spans many real and synthetic 3D datasets, while experiments cover camera pose, multi-view depth, point maps, matching, novel-view synthesis, and tracking. Broad 3D-vision evidence still excludes daily domains such as software engineering, incident diagnosis, or business decisions. The five-step framework in this study is therefore a design hypothesis inferred from the paper's architecture, ablations, and optimization results. Each transfer should predefine its baseline, cost, quality metric, and fallback condition.
en.takeaway: Use shared context, redundant supervision, and optional refinement as an experiment checklist, not a validated recipe

zh-TW.title: 論文證據尚不能回答這套設計原則在日常跨域任務是否有效
zh-TW.body: 論文訓練使用多個真實與合成 3D 資料集，實驗涵蓋相機姿態、多視角深度、點圖、配對、新視角合成與追蹤。這些廣泛的 3D 視覺結果仍未包含軟體工程、事故診斷、商業決策等日常任務。因此，本研究提出的五步框架是從論文架構、消融與最佳化結果推導的設計假設；每次移植都應預先定義基線、成本、品質與回退條件。
zh-TW.takeaway: 把共同情境、冗餘監督與可選精修當作實驗檢查表，不要當作已驗證配方

card.summary: A transcript should keep a path back to the recording and show what cleanup changed. I built a local Android workflow that verifies saved audio before recognition and lets the user approve suggested removals.
card.evidence: Prototype path: saved source → local ASR → approved cleanup → editable text → explicit Copy.

en.subtitle: From a spoken thought to words the speaker controls.
en.lead: I wanted to speak an unfinished thought and keep ownership of the final wording. That meant preserving the recording and making recognition, cleanup, and editing separate steps.

sections.heading: The speaker's problem
paragraphs: An unfinished thought can contain fillers, repetitions, and self-corrections. Recognition may get words wrong, while an aggressive cleanup can erase something the speaker meant to keep.

Transcribe-for-X keeps a path back to SourceAudio, presents RawTranscript separately from cleanup suggestions, and leaves the final wording with the user. Its current implementation is an Android Voice-to-Words foundation with local recognition.

sections.heading: The choice I made
paragraphs: I put verified storage before recognition. SourceRepository checks capture evidence, syncs and saves the recording, reads it back, compares size and SHA-256, and records a manifest. AsrGateway must resolve a verified source before invoking the local NativeWhisper engine.

I also kept cleanup conservative: TranscriptCleanup proposes removals, the user accepts or rejects them individually, and the projection is checked to remove only accepted spans. This adds storage, failure handling, and review work, while keeping the source and the speaker's decisions visible.

sections.heading: What it produces today
paragraphs: The Android implementation connects recording and verified source storage to local ASR, per-suggestion cleanup, editable final text, and an explicit Copy action. That gives the project a concrete product path, with raw recognition and user-approved changes kept distinct.
The current result is an implemented Android path. Mixed Traditional Chinese/English recognition quality, microphone behavior, recovery, and private real-use acceptance still need separate evidence.

zh-TW.subtitle: 把口述想法變成作者仍能掌握的文字。
zh-TW.lead: 我希望能說出未成形的想法，也保有最後措辭的決定權。因此，先留下錄音，再把辨識、清理建議與編輯分開。

sections.heading: 說話者的問題
paragraphs: 未成形的想法可能包含語助詞、重複與自我修正。辨識可能聽錯，而過度的 cleanup 也可能刪掉說話者原本想保留的意思。
Transcribe-for-X 保留原始錄音，分開呈現原始逐字稿與清理建議，讓使用者決定最後措辭。目前是採用本機語音辨識的 Android 原型。

sections.heading: 我的關鍵選擇
paragraphs: 我把錄音保存與驗證放在辨識之前。SourceRepository 檢查錄音是否完整、同步寫入檔案，再讀回比對大小與 SHA-256，留下檔案紀錄。AsrGateway 必須取得已驗證的來源，才能呼叫本機 NativeWhisper 引擎。
文字清理採保守設計：TranscriptCleanup 提出刪除建議，使用者逐項接受或拒絕，再檢查輸出只移除了已接受的片段。這增加了儲存、失敗處理與確認步驟，也保留了來源與使用者的決定。

sections.heading: 目前可看見的結果
paragraphs: Android 原型已串接錄音保存、本機辨識、逐項清理建議、文字編輯與複製；原始辨識結果與使用者接受的修改分開保留。
正體中文／English 混合語音品質、麥克風行為、失敗復原與實際使用體驗仍待測試。

card.summary: An anchored usage window can reset while you are away from the keyboard. I built a planner that compares timings against working hours and previews the command before a live clock-in.
card.evidence: Outputs: a workday schedule, a no-tool baseline, and a dry-run command preview. Account benefit depends on actual window behavior.

en.subtitle: A workday schedule you can inspect before running.
en.lead: I wanted to see whether a fixed usage-window schedule could line up with my working hours. windowphase makes the timing, baseline, and clock-in command explicit before a live request.

sections.heading: The workday problem
paragraphs: If a provider uses a request-anchored window, the time of the first request shapes when the next reset arrives. Those boundaries can fall outside the hours when the allowance is useful.

windowphase models a five-hour window against the workday and looks for reset boundaries that leave usable portions of time on either side. It compares the proposed schedule with the no-tool baseline, so the calculation has a concrete point of comparison.

sections.heading: The choice I made
paragraphs: I separated the planner from provider execution. The Python calculation returns pre-work ignition, reset times, and reachable windows under a minimum usable-slice constraint; spacing validation also checks the gap across midnight.

Provider adapters build explicit command arguments, and the runner defaults to a dry run. A live clock-in requires live=True or --live. This makes the plan inspectable, while leaving the real provider behavior and request cost as assumptions that must be checked separately.

example.label: Illustrative model example — not an account measurement
example.text: For a 09:00–18:00 workday and a 60-minute minimum usable slice, the anchored model places clock-ins at 06:00, 11:00, and 16:00. These are calculated times under the model, not a measured account benefit.

sections.heading: What it produces today
paragraphs: The project provides schedule calculation and rendering, a no-tool comparison, provider command previews, a ledger, and health-check code. Scheduler representations exist for systemd, launchd, and Windows Task Scheduler.

The bounded result is a calculated schedule and an inspectable CLI path. A rolling lookback may make the anchored model unsuitable; actual quota benefit and parity across Linux, macOS, and Windows remain unestablished.

zh-TW.subtitle: 先檢查工作日排程，再決定是否執行。
zh-TW.lead: 我想讓五小時使用視窗的起點配合工作日。windowphase 先列出啟動時間、重設時刻與要執行的指令，讓使用者看過排程後，再決定是否真的送出請求。

sections.heading: 工作時段的問題
paragraphs: 如果服務的使用視窗由第一次請求開始計時，第一次使用的時間就會影響下一次重設。重設時刻可能落在不工作、也用不到額度的時段。
windowphase 以五小時視窗為模型，尋找能在工作時間內留下足夠可用區段的安排，並與不使用工具的排程比較。這是模型計算，不能直接當成帳號實際增加的額度。

sections.heading: 我的關鍵選擇
paragraphs: 我把排程計算與服務執行分開。Python 程式根據最短可用時段，計算上班前啟動、重設時間與可用視窗；也檢查跨午夜的間隔。
服務轉接器產生明確的指令參數，runner 預設只預覽（dry run）。必須明確指定 live=True 或 --live 才會送出請求；服務實際如何計時與每次請求的成本仍需另外確認。

example.label: 模型示例，並非帳號量測
example.text: 工作日為 09:00–18:00、最短可用時段為 60 分鐘時，模型安排在 06:00、11:00、16:00 啟動請求。這些是模型算出的時刻，不是帳號效益的實測。

sections.heading: 目前可看見的結果
paragraphs: 專案提供排程計算、基線比較、服務指令預覽、執行紀錄與健康檢查程式，並有 systemd、launchd 和 Windows Task Scheduler 的排程設定表示。
目前可確認的是計算出的排程與可檢查的 CLI。若服務採用滾動回溯視窗，這個模型可能不適用；實際額度效益及三種作業系統的一致表現尚未驗證。
